fields.description: Berkeley Tower is Ellington’s Grade A office development in Business Bay, with workspaces, shared business facilities and leisure amenities in a tower beside Sheikh Zayed Road.
amenities: Proposed vertiport and drone delivery provision

sources.label: Ellington Berkeley Tower interactive office plans and payment schedule
Berkeley Tower official office floor plans

reviewCoverage.identity: Exact commercial project page and Berkeley-labelled 29-page brochure, 71-page brief, 21-page plans and one-page payment sheet reviewed. Distinct from residential Berkeley Place.
reviewCoverage.location: Own project body and plan compass diagrams identify Business Bay along Sheikh Zayed Road beside Business Bay Metro. Mapped existing Business Bay area.
reviewCoverage.residences: Grade A commercial offices, including full-floor, duplex and triplex configurations; bedrooms not applicable.
reviewCoverage.areas: All 21 plan pages text-read; actual individual A/B/C/D/E/F drawings on pages 15–20 visually read. Brief page 20 and brochure page 4 visually read. Source discrepancies retained; no reconciliation by assumption.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Own project body and public microsite identify co-working, clubhouse, fitness, games and proposed future mobility infrastructure. Planned facilities, not operational services.
reviewCoverage.pricing: No current office quotation or project starting price appears in the reviewed primary documents. Promotional development value is not an office price; headline null.
reviewCoverage.payment: Own one-page schedule visually checked against live microsite: 20 + ten 5 + 30 = 100. Dates are relative to reservation and construction milestones.
reviewCoverage.handover: No calendar completion date identified in primary brochure, brief, payment sheet or own project/microsite. Secondary estimates disagree; no estimated year adopted.
reviewCoverage.documents: Public exact official assets linked from materials locator retrieved without forms. Own microsite floor selector has mislabelled ranges/floor references, so actual PDF drawings govern the illustrative examples. No photos or private stock imported.

overview: Office floors are paired with shared work, fitness and social spaces. The public materials include both single-level offices and larger workplaces across multiple levels.
research.locationNote: Business Bay, Dubai, along Sheikh Zayed Road beside Business Bay Metro. Published drive times are marketing estimates, not measured commuting guarantees.
research.priceNote: No current primary starting price was found. Request a dated quotation identifying the office, usable area, fit-out specification and all acquisition charges.
research.paymentNote: The published schedule totals 100%, with 70% before completion and 30% at completion. Confirm reservation dates, construction triggers, taxes, fees and any offer-specific changes in writing.
research.handoverNote: The reviewed primary material gives no calendar handover date. Obtain the contractual completion programme rather than relying on conflicting third-party forecasts.

facts.label: Building and lifts
facts.value: G+60; 12 double-deck passenger lifts. Floor-to-ceiling heights 3.8–4.1 m.

facts.label: Service charge reference
facts.value: Anticipated AED 24/ft²; billing period and final approved budget require confirmation.

facts.label: Primary document discrepancies
facts.value: Brochure range 2,504.01–22,588.71 ft² differs from detailed plans. Brief full-floor/duplex/triplex totals 12,182/21,873/22,191 differ from the individual examples below. Duplex levels 54–55 versus 56–57, and triplex 56–58 versus 58–60, also conflict. No revision chronology is assumed.

unresolved: Office E components total 22,089.80 ft², but its printed total is 22,090.45; retained as printed. Smaller 0.01 ft² component differences also occur.
Approved floor allocation and area require reconciliation with the developer before selection; public microsite also mislabels some floor ranges.

Current price, availability, fit-out delivery, parking allocation, fee basis and contractual completion are not confirmed. Future vertiport and drone provisions are proposals, not operating transport services.
